brief: Build an evidence-backed action plan that separates decisions possible now from questions needing qualified help.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "An actionable plan"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Un plan realizable"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Um plano realizável"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Build an evidence-backed action plan that separates decisions possible now from questions needing qualified help.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Separate a useful action today from questions needing qualified local help.
instruction.misconception: Treating every unresolved question as a reason to stop, or inventing legal answers to make a plan look complete.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use the explicitly stated totals, deadlines and constraints. Earlier financial arithmetic is retrieved; no current rate or legal entitlement is implied.

evidence.reasoning: A dated bill list is concrete and needs no spare money.
Verify qualified local support before trusting a sweeping promise.
The applicable local source establishes the relevant filing rule.
Knowing a password does not establish legal authority over an estate.
Accurate records let support assess the real constraints.
A recorded official answer resolves a specific uncertainty without spare money.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.prompt: Which action can be checked today?
en-US.scene: No spare money; goal: identify next week’s unpaid obligations.

options.label: List each bill and its due date

help: Choose an observable next action within current resources.

feedback.not_yet: Choose an observable next action within current resources.

feedback.not_yet: Elige una acción observable con los recursos actuales.

pt-BR.scene: Não sobra dinheiro; você quer saber quais contas vencem na próxima semana.
help: Escolha algo que pode fazer e conferir hoje.

feedback.met: Você pode fazer a lista com datas sem gastar dinheiro.
feedback.not_yet: Escolha algo que pode fazer e conferir hoje.

en-US.scene: No feasible plan covers essentials; an ad promises debt erasure for upfront payment.
help: A guarantee in an advertisement does not establish legitimate help.

feedback.met: Verify qualified local support before trusting a sweeping promise.
feedback.not_yet: A guarantee in an advertisement does not establish legitimate help.

help: A foreign deadline cannot establish your local obligation.

feedback.met: The applicable local source establishes the relevant filing rule.
feedback.not_yet: A foreign deadline cannot establish your local obligation.

help: O prazo de outro país não define o seu.

feedback.met: A fonte oficial local informa a regra que vale ali.
feedback.not_yet: O prazo de outro país não define o seu.

help: Verify authority through qualified local advice before acting on funds.
